name: Ujitawara (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ujitawara town emblem in white: a stylised tea leaf enclosing a green swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Ujitawara, a town in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 November 1969.

features.role: Ujitawara town emblem — a stylised tea leaf enclosing a green swirl
